card.one_sentence_claim: SBT's directionality certificate forces the structural form of any admissible sustained "effective force": within the AUT+REV+ACC regime, the log-ratio 1-form a(z,z')=log(P/P^T) certifies an arrow only when non-exact (nonzero cycle integral), so no cycles (forest, beta_1=0) or exactness implies no drive, recovering the Schnakenberg/discrete-Hodge necessity that nonequilibrium directionality lives only on positive-cycle-rank support.
card.target_known_fact: In Markov-network stochastic thermodynamics, nonequilibrium steady-state entropy production / affinity is supported entirely on graph cycles: a gradient (exact) affinity carries no circulation, tree/forest topologies carry no drive, and detailed-balance chains have zero entropy production. Force-like (sustained-arrow) structure requires positive cycle rank (first Betti number beta_1>0). This is Schnakenberg's cycle decomposition combined with discrete Hodge decomposition and Kelly's reversibility-implies-time-symmetry.

main_steps: Step 1 (fix the certificate object): under A_FIN+A_REV+A_ACC declare the directionality certificate to be the antisymmetric log-ratio 1-form a=log(P/P^T) on the bidirected support graph; the P6_drive face is the non-exact part. State explicitly that Sigma_T (path-space KL) is the audit functional and that AT THE STATIONARY MEASURE (A_STAT) Sigma_T=T*EPR with EPR positive iff a is non-exact (Protocol_Trap eq:sigmaT_epr), where the positive direction uses the cited Schnakenberg current-times-affinity decomposition.

Step 2 (necessity from topology): invoke thm:NG_FORCE_FOREST -- if beta_1(G)=0 (forest), a is exact, so by thm:NG_FORCE_NULL all cycle affinities vanish and EPR=0; hence no sustained arrow. Contrapositive: a sustained arrow forces beta_1>0.

Step 3 (necessity from exactness): invoke thm:cycle-criterion-exact -- even with beta_1>0, if a is exact (gradient/gauge) then every cycle sum vanishes (cor:null-regime gives detailed balance), so EPR=0; hence the certificate fires ONLY for a non-exact 1-form. This is the uniqueness half (NECESSITY only): the ONLY admissible carrier is a non-exact 1-form on positive-cycle-rank support. The matching sufficiency (non-exact => arrow) is supplied by the cited Schnakenberg decomposition, not internally derived.

Step 4 (closure under admissible moves): use T-P2-01 to show gating/edge-deletion cannot manufacture drive (beta_1 non-increasing), and T-P1-01 to enumerate the only escape route that raises beta_1 (operator rewrite adding a cyclic edge); combine with protocol-trap (autonomous reversible lift gives Sigma_T=0, EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock) to exclude P3 holonomy and external schedules as fake-arrow sources.

Step 5 (recovery statement / honest labeling): state that Steps 2-4 reproduce exactly Schnakenberg's cycle decomposition of NESS affinity + discrete Hodge (exact=gradient=no circulation) + Kelly reversibility; flag that the contribution is a reorganization into one audit-monotone necessity with explicit escape routes (break exactness / add cycle rank via P1 / external schedule), NOT new physics. Emphasize the certificate is informational (path-space KL), not physical entropy production (honoring the micro-thermodynamic disclaimer).
data_comparison_steps: Reproduce the protocol-trap benchmark numbers as a consistency check: reversible (unbiased) clock gives EPR_lifted < 1e-17 (machine zero), confirming exact 1-form => zero certificate; driven 3-cycle gives EPR=alpha*beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)) matching Schnakenberg current-times-affinity (b=0.5 -> 0.2472, b=0.9 -> 1.1925 at alpha=0.5,beta=0.9).

Run the Appendix-C graph routine (Foundations sec:acc) on (i) a tree kernel, (ii) a reversible 3-cycle, (iii) a biased 3-cycle: verify cycle-affinity coordinate vector A_r is identically zero in (i),(ii) and nonzero in (iii); verify beta_1 computed as |E|-|V|+c matches forest vs cycle classification.

Verify T-P2-01 numerically: delete a chord edge from the biased 3-cycle, renormalize, confirm beta_1 drops 1->0 and the certificate (max cycle affinity) collapses to 0 -- demonstrating gating cannot sustain the arrow.

Optional cross-check against a standard stochastic-thermodynamics reference computation (e.g. a 4-state ring with one biased edge): confirm SBT cycle-affinity coordinates equal the textbook Schnakenberg affinities A_alpha = log(prod forward / prod backward) around each fundamental cycle.

card.baseline_comparison: RECOVERY, not improvement. Every mathematical ingredient is a standard finite-graph / stochastic-thermodynamics fact: forest-exactness and zero-cycle-sum-of-gradients are elementary graph theory (Diestel, Biggs, cited at No-Go line 297); the exact<=>zero-cycle-affinity equivalence is the discrete Hodge / cycle-space decomposition (Lim 2020, cited); cycle affinities as nonequilibrium forces is exactly Schnakenberg (1976, cited Protocol_Trap line 278); detailed-balance => zero EPR / time-symmetric paths is Kelly (1979). SBT does NOT do better than the standard account on any quantitative claim and explicitly cites all four. What is genuinely (modestly) reorganized: (i) packaging these into a single uniqueness-NECESSITY statement about the admissible CARRIER of a directionality certificate, audit-monotone under coarse-graining (the DPI rider: coarse-graining cannot create the affinity); (ii) the explicit escape-route taxonomy (break exactness / raise beta_1 via a P1 operator rewrite / add an external schedule outside A_AUT); (iii) the clean separation of P3 protocol holonomy (route mismatch) from P6 directionality, proved as the protocol trap. These are conceptual/organizational, not new physics. The known result being RECOVERED is Schnakenberg + discrete Hodge + Kelly; the genuine REORGANIZATION is the audit-monotone necessity-with-escape-routes framing and the P3-vs-P6 firewall. ALREADY logged as a recovery in ledger already_claimed_retrodictions line 159.
card.why_scientists_care: It gives a crisp, falsification-first necessity condition with operational teeth: any observed sustained current/circulation NECESSARILY certifies positive cycle rank and a non-exact affinity, and conversely any model attributing a sustained arrow to forest/tree topology, to a gradient (potential) affinity, or to protocol holonomy alone is provably making a category error. As an audit, it tells a modeler exactly the three (and only three, within the autonomous theorem object) ways to legitimately introduce drive, and the protocol-trap firewall (P3 holonomy is not an arrow) flags a genuinely common conflation in switched-Markov, stochastic-pump, and algorithmic-protocol modeling. The compression of Schnakenberg + Hodge + reversibility into one monotone certificate with explicit escape routes is a useful pedagogical and diagnostic normal form, even though no new physical content is produced.

card.execution_cost: Low. The mathematics of the necessity half is fully proved in the cited papers (all required lemmas are 'trivial'/'easy' and already_in_papers=true), so the core is logical assembly. The numerical demonstration reuses an existing public repository (github.com/ioannist/six-birds-protocol-trap) and the Foundations Appendix-C graph routine; a fresh cross-check against a textbook 4-state ring is a few hours of coding. The only nontrivial-effort options are the stronger results: the H^1/gauge-invariance quantitative decomposition + internal sufficiency derivation (modest, ~days, partly just citing) and Lean-certifying the two graph theorems (days, but elementary). Honesty/framing review is the real cost, not computation.
card.honest_status_note: This is Derivability Class A but NOT a discovery: it is a logical repackaging of already-proved SBT theorems that themselves faithfully recover standard results (Schnakenberg cycle affinities, discrete Hodge exact=gradient=no-circulation, Kelly reversibility=time-symmetry). The 'uniqueness-necessity' is an immediate corollary of thm:cycle-criterion-exact for the NECESSITY direction; the sufficiency direction is imported. Honest caveats: (1) the result is about the INFORMATIONAL audit 1-form / path-space KL, NOT physical force or physical entropy production -- the micro-thermodynamic interpretation is explicitly disclaimed by SBT and must not be smuggled in; (2) the theorems require EXACT bidirected support and exact ratio-form data -- real, thresholded/estimated support graphs lie outside the theorem object, limiting direct empirical bite until a perturbation/thresholded extension is proved; (3) the FORCE_FOREST/NULL graph theorems are paper-proved only, NOT in the Lean-certified core (which covers TV-DPI and contraction uniqueness); claiming machine-checked necessity today would be inaccurate; (4) the general current-times-affinity decomposition (and hence the sufficiency half non-exact=>EPR>0) is cited from Schnakenberg, not derived internally; (5) EPR is stationary-measure-dependent (A_STAT) whereas exactness is kernel-only, so the Sigma_T=T*EPR<=>non-exact link is not a measure-free corollary. Net: a clean, honest, low-cost normal-form/diagnostic contribution with a small genuine-novelty budget (audit-monotone framing + escape-route taxonomy + P3-vs-P6 firewall), and no claim to new physics.

audit.audit_verdict: HONEST RECOVERY, NOT A RETRODICTION. A faithfully-labeled logical repackaging of already-proved, elementary SBT theorems that recover textbook Schnakenberg cycle affinities, discrete Hodge, and Kelly reversibility. Mathematical claim has near-zero fitting freedom but also LOW novelty and LOW empirical content. Real freedom is implicit and disclaimed: underived lens fixes the support graph (HIGH risk), and EPR=force identification imports disclaimed micro-thermodynamic meaning. The abstract theorem cannot fake an arrow on a forest, but re-lensing/P1 rewrites/external schedules let the applied framework accommodate either outcome. Target leakage present and admitted. Guardrails: do not call the informational 1-form a physical force; do not claim empirical bite under exact-support.
